name: LLM Atlas
desc: A detailed, interactive course on large language models: from the mathematics of machine learning and the Transformer to pretraining, alignment, inference, applications and safety.
desc_zh: 深入、可交互的大语言模型课程：从机器学习的数学基础和Transformer，到预训练、对齐、推理部署、应用与安全。
lede: A detailed, interactive course on large language models — from the mathematics of machine learning, neural networks and the Transformer to pretraining, post-training, reasoning, inference, agents, evaluation and safety. Courses are arranged in four stages, from foundations to the research frontier. Every course and chapter is mapped out and the lessons are being written: each course below shows how many of its chapters are written.
lede_zh: 深入、可交互的大语言模型课程——从机器学习的数学、神经网络和Transformer，到预训练、后训练、推理能力、推理部署、智能体、评测与安全。课程分为四个阶段，从基础一直到研究前沿。每门课程和每一章都已规划好，课文正在编写中：下面每门课程都标明了已完成的章数。
foot: a free, detailed and interactive course on large language models, from first principles to current research, written to be read alongside lectures, papers and textbooks.
foot_zh: 一套免费、详尽、可交互的大语言模型课程，从基本原理一直讲到当前研究，可配合课堂、论文和教材阅读。
about_lede: LLM Atlas is a free, detailed course on how large language models work, how they are trained and used, and how to make them safe — written to be read alongside lectures, papers and textbooks, or on its own.
about_lede_zh: 大语言模型图谱是一套免费、详尽的课程，讲解大语言模型如何工作、如何训练和使用，以及如何让它们安全可靠——可以配合课堂、论文和教材阅读，也可以单独自学。
timeline_desc: From information theory and the first neural networks to today’s language models: the ideas behind every course in the atlas.
timeline_desc_zh: 从信息论和最早的神经网络到今天的语言模型：图谱中每门课程背后的思想。
timeline_lede: The ideas behind the courses, from Markov’s chains of letters and Shannon’s information theory to neural networks, the Transformer and modern language models. Coloured dots show the area; links lead to the course where the idea is taught.
timeline_lede_zh: 各门课程背后的思想：从马尔可夫的字母链和香农的信息论，到神经网络、Transformer和现代语言模型。彩色圆点表示所属领域；链接指向讲授该内容的课程。
card_desc: Large language models from first principles: the mathematics of machine learning, neural networks and the Transformer, pretraining and scaling, post-training and reasoning, inference, agents, evaluation, interpretability and safety. The curriculum is mapped out; the lessons are still to be written.
card_desc_zh: 从基本原理讲解大语言模型：机器学习的数学、神经网络与Transformer、预训练与规模化、后训练与推理能力、推理部署、智能体、评测、可解释性与安全。课程体系已经规划好，课文尚待编写。
sources: The lessons are original texts that follow the standard textbooks and the original papers, and each course page recommends books and papers for further reading. The courses and chapters are all mapped out, and the lessons are being written; the atlas home page shows how many chapters of each course are written.
sources_zh: 课文均为原创，依据标准教材和原始论文编写，每门课程页面都推荐了延伸阅读的书籍和论文。课程与章节都已规划好，课文正在编写中；图谱首页标明了每门课程已完成的章数。

areas.label: Maths & ML foundations
areas.blurb: The mathematics of machine learning, learning from data and neural networks.
areas.blurb_zh: 机器学习的数学、从数据中学习以及神经网络。

areas.label: Language modelling
areas.blurb: Text and tokens, sequence models, attention and the Transformer.
areas.blurb_zh: 文本与词元、序列模型、注意力机制与Transformer。

areas.label: Pretraining & scaling
areas.blurb: Data, objectives, scaling laws and training across thousands of accelerators.
areas.blurb_zh: 数据、训练目标、缩放定律以及在数千块加速器上的训练。

areas.label: Applications
areas.blurb: Prompting, retrieval, tools, agents and multimodal models.
areas.blurb_zh: 提示、检索、工具、智能体与多模态模型。

areas.label: Evaluation, safety & society
areas.blurb: Measuring models, understanding them, making them safe and their effect on society.
areas.blurb_zh: 评测模型、理解模型、让模型安全，以及模型对社会的影响。

areas.label: Post-training & reasoning
areas.blurb: Instruction tuning, learning from feedback and training models to reason.
areas.blurb_zh: 指令微调、从反馈中学习以及训练模型进行推理。

areas.label: Inference & systems
areas.blurb: Decoding, serving, quantisation and the cost of every token.
areas.blurb_zh: 解码、服务部署、量化以及每个词元的成本。

courses.title: Text and Language
courses.full_title: Text, Tokens and Classical Language Models
